stories.title: Welsh Government urged to keep free milk for 80,000 primary school children after Senedd vote
stories.summary: Ministers are under pressure to keep free school milk for 80,000 primary school children in Wales, after Senedd Members backed a call to rule out axing the scheme. stories.title: Essar Oil ordered to pay £873,473 over Stanlow refinery wastewater breaches
stories.summary: The operator of Stanlow oil refinery has been fined nearly £900,000 after breaking pollution limits on its wastewater at least 489 times in three years. stories.title: One in four Wrexham Maelor AE patients spent 12 hours or more there in October
stories.summary: Just over a third of patients at Wrexham Maelor Hospital’s emergency department were seen within four hours in October, new Welsh Government figures show. stories.title: LINK to carry out new assessment of Holywell banking needs after town lost its last bank
stories.summary: LINK, which runs the UK’s cash machine network, will carry out a new assessment of Holywell’s banking needs after the town lost its last bank.
